metadata.description: Claude Code plugins that extend the engineering skills: guards, a Gate and the road from a pull request to merged.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Guards on every tool call and the road from a pull request to merged, beside the engineering skills and replacing none: refuses destructive git, unvouched env files, the wrong package manager and sloppy commits; routes Bash through rtk when present; syncs References; skills to set a repository up, check a machine, open, ship and sweep pull requests. Needs jq and Node 24.

plugins.name: sdlc-sessions
plugins.description: Session skills beside sdlc: /sdlc-recap says where a session stands and whether it can close, /sdlc-kickoff writes a Brief and starts a new Lead to carry it, and /sdlc-delegate makes the session a Lead that runs Workers in herdr terminals and gathers their Recaps. It depends on sdlc, so every session keeps its guards.
